card.name: Christian scripture and catechism citations
card.fires_on: Citation markers in Christian religious text, such as Bible verse references (Eph. 5:19, Psa. 51:6), Book of Mormon references, and Catechism tags like CCC2223. Also words inside devotional book commentary.

modes.label: Scripture reference
modes.description: Book abbreviations, spaces and colons inside Bible or Book of Mormon verse citations.

modes.label: Catechism citation
modes.description: The CCC tag or its number in a bracketed Catechism reference.

modes.label: Christian book commentary
modes.description: Ordinary words in sentences about God and faith, from reviews of Christian books.
modes.example: glorifying God with our minds<< and>> hearts is not either-or

card.writes: It pushes toward the word Christian and Christianity, and away from flesh and Galatians.
card.plain: It fires in Christian religious writing, especially at Bible verse and Catechism citations.
